text: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发布关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见。其中提出，健全研用一体的成果转化应用机制，产业应用目标明确的国家科技计划项目，原则上由企业牵头实施并主导成果转化。支持高校、科研院所设立技术转移机构或岗位，强化知识产权、创业孵化、科技金融等专业化服务，通过技术转让、许可、作价投资等方式加快成果应用。
text_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued opinions on promoting the deep integration of technological innovation and industrial innovation. Among them, it is proposed to improve the mechanism for transforming and applying research results with integrated R&D and application, and for national science and technology plan projects with clear industrial application goals, enterprises should in principle lead implementation and lead results transformation. Support universities and research institutes in setting up technology transfer institutions or positions, strengthen specialized services such as intellectual property, business incubation, and sci-tech finance, and accelerate the application of results through technology transfer, licensing, and investment at appraised value.
